newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks open higher, then slip in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: French stocks open higher, then slip in quiet trade.

text.p: French shares opened higher on Monday but slid back in thin trading.

"There's no news to send the market either up or down," a trader said. Weaker bond prices were putting pressure on the bourse but the dollar's rise above 6.28 francs was providing support, brokers said.
The CAC-40 index was down 14.45 points, or 0.47 percent, at 3,034.99 at 0822 GMT. The CAC-40 August futures contract eased to 3,041 from 3,054 at Friday's close.
The broader SBF120 index was down 8.1 points at 2,073.56.
Volume was a thin 490 million francs, as many operators are on holiday.
Dollar earners such as L'Oreal, up 1.02 percent at 2,470 francs, were faring best on the bourse.
